General information only — not medical advice. Consult a professional for personal guidance. See a doctor about a persistently high or suddenly changed resting heart rate.

📖 How to use

  1. Each morning, measure your resting heart rate before getting up.
  2. Log the date and BPM.
  3. Watch your 7-day average and trend arrow.
  4. Read the fitness interpretation for your range.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I measure resting heart rate?

Measure right after waking, before getting up: count beats for 60 seconds or use a wearable's morning reading.

How is the trend calculated?

The tool compares your last 3 readings against the previous ones to show rising, falling, or stable trends.

What is a good resting heart rate?

Roughly: under 60 athletic, 60–70 good, 70–80 average, 80–100 below average, over 100 high. Individual variation is normal.

Why does it drop with fitness?

A lower resting heart rate generally reflects better cardiovascular fitness — but see a doctor about sudden changes.
